title: Comic Vine Series Gap by Publisher
dataSources: Discogs collection entries (`discogs:item`), comics (`comic:item`), coin catalogue entries (`coin:item`), stamp album entries (`stamp:item`), and watch logs (`watch:item`).
app: Collection telemetry from Discogs, Comic Vine, coin and stamp catalogues, and watch-collection trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=comic:item
| search missing_issue_count=*
| stats sum(missing_issue_count) as missing_issue_count count as tracked_series by publisher
| sort 0 - missing_issue_count
description: Ranks publisherss by missing comic issues.
value: Publisher-level gap counts help decide where finishing a run may be easier or more expensive.
implementation: Send missing comic issues events to `index=personal` and keep `publisher` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of missing comic issues by publishers.
grandmaExplanation: It totals which publisherss stand out most for missing comic issues.
